record_scope_reconstruction: Thakhek–Nakhon Phanom municipal passenger ferry service, suspended from March 17, 2020 and ordinarily restored October 3, 2022. Emergency repatriation voyages remain exceptions. Friendship Bridge III is a separate road crossing.

source_checks.finding: Original report identifies Thakhek port closing at 14:00 March 17 while Friendship Bridge III remains open.
Indexed government reopening article reports October 3 passenger sailings at the municipal tourism jetty after the March 2020 suspension. Direct open failed.
Named ferry terminal node and coordinates inspected.

date_scope_check.qualification: October 3 2022 is observed ordinary-service restoration at this ferry only. March 18 2020 immigration clarification allowed stranded Thai/Lao nationals to return through Thakhek despite closure; exception duration and volume unknown. Third Friendship Bridge remained alternative. No total cessation of all passenger crossings asserted.

unresolved: Exact Thai municipal passenger pier remains unverified; nearby Saeng Sing Kaeo pier is not assumed equivalent. Only the Lao terminal is approved.
